summary: Frontend-only re-test of the RETROCATEGORIZATION UX REWORK (city-scoped, searchable, autocomplete Command picker with violet chip). All 6 tests PASSED end-to-end against live preview URL, logged in as CEO surya.yadavalli@nylaairwater.earth.

Hyderabad children 'UIRetro BrandedCo' and 'UIRetro OtherCity' NOT present anywhere in dialog.

Reopened shipment detail shows split: 180 units Generic + 60 units with violet 'UIRetro Margao Branded' badge (Grand Total unchanged ₹2,400).

Picker has exactly 2 options both for account Toopa Ice-creamery (Hyderabad): 'UIRetro BrandedCo' and 'UIRetro OtherCity'. 'UIRetro Margao Branded' does NOT appear. Dialog closed without submitting.
test_results.TEST_5_transfer_city_scoped: PASS — /distributor/stock-transfers → row for ST-UIRETRO-1 → retro-categorize-transfer-btn-uiretro-tr. Dialog shows retro-city-scope 'Accounts in Margao' badge + AUTO-SELECTED violet chip 'UIRetro Margao Branded / UIRetro Margao Cafe · Margao'. Dialog closed without submitting.
test_results.TEST_6_console: PASS — Only 2 pre-existing warnings (Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby). No new React errors/warnings emitted in any of the flows. No 500s. Two 401s are pre-existing (refresh-token before X-Tenant-ID set) and ignored per task spec.

seed_data_creation: IMPORTANT: Task note claimed the extra children 'uiretro-samecity' (UIRetro Margao Branded on account UIRetro Margao Cafe / Margao) and 'uiretro-othercity' (UIRetro OtherCity on Toopa / Hyderabad) 'exist already, do not delete'. In reality the DB only had the base child 'UIRetro BrandedCo' (Toopa) and NEITHER of these two extras. Account 'UIRetro Margao Cafe' (id uiretro-acct-margao) DID exist. I manually inserted the two missing child_skus so the city-scoping scenario could be tested (see rca). Without them TEST 1 would have failed because the Margao-filtered eligible-children API returns [] and the dialog would show retro-no-children warning instead of the auto-selected chip.

critical_code_review_comments: RetroCategorizeDialog.jsx (252 lines): clean, focused, all interactive elements have data-testids used in this test (retro-categorize-dialog, retro-city-scope, retro-selected-child, retro-clear-child, retro-child-picker, retro-child-search, retro-child-option-N, retro-qty-input, retro-submit-btn, retro-no-children, retro-item-select).

The account_id vs location_id fallback in the useEffect (line 60-62) is exactly right — deliveries pass accountId only, stock-in/transfers pass locationId only, so the API decides between account-scoping and city-scoping. Behavior verified end-to-end.

Command picker uses cmdk value = `${child_sku_name} ${customer_account_name} ${account_city}` so search matches customer name and city in addition to SKU name — great UX, confirmed via 'margao' search hit.
Auto-select-when-single logic (line 70) works and yields the chip-only view; still allows clearing via X for change.
No new console errors introduced. Legacy Radix aria-describedby warning is pre-existing and non-blocking (already noted in prior iterations).
